title: Logos / Logotype
slide_intent: Tie a signature to existing recognition because inherited visual features can connect different parts of an identity.
strategic_value: The eyebrow-like g and Duo-derived curves can carry Duolingo’s character even without the full mascot.
demonstration: The logotype specimen accompanies an explanation of its mascot-derived letterforms and permitted colors.
practical_value: Select an approved wordmark color and preserve its custom drawing.
